why: The playground is what the owner opens to judge v3, and it reads as an archive: 165 nav entries in 12 sections, seven of them trial evidence, a landing page that lists 105 scenarios as links, three phone tabs. Superseded cycle builds (dogfood 1 to 4, shell 2 to 5, state 2 to 3: 20 route files, 5.7k lines) still ship in the nav and in every matrix cell. `/charts` imports the built dist by relative path and loads a second copy of the chart module; `/table`, the exemplar the table skill names, hand-builds a Sheet where the table now owns its record panel. Six public parts have no page. The owner, 2026-11-24: "a cleaned up playground, which is adhering to modern Basalt UI patterns, modern great renderings". Evidence: docs/v3/evidence/readiness-2026-11-24/playground.md (work items WI-2 to WI-9 and its section 4 on what tests pin).
what: The playground opens on a tour of about twelve pages that show v3 as it is meant to be used, and nothing superseded is left.
owns: apps/playground/src/routes/**, src/demo/nav-model.tsx, src/cycle/**, a new apps/playground/AGENTS.md
the tests and waivers that name a deleted route (page-top layout test, scripts/consumers.json, matrix waivers)
must_not_touch: the vite config and `.basalt/` (ga-install-path, which lands first)
packages/basalt-ui/src except a defect a tour page exposes (own commit, named in the PR)
the routes the skill tests and the matrix pin (playground.md section 4), unless the test is repointed in the same PR
change: Read first: docs/v3/issues/ga/README.md, then the evidence file named in why (every finding there has path:line). Decided: (1) Nav: one "Tour" section first, then Kit and Reference collapsed; no scenario or cycle section. Scenarios stay routable for the tests and are reached from one index page, not the nav. The landing page is the tour. (2) The tour, each a page a consumer could have built from the skills: shell, list with saved views in the grid look, a reading-look table, board, record with panels, settings, a form with a wizard dialog, dashboard, charts, content, states and overlays (new `/kit/states` using `OverlayHost`, `ConnectionIndicator`, `RefreshButton`, `Toc`, `StepRail`, `ControlView`), and the phone projection shown as a viewport. Use existing ref and kit pages where they already are that page. (3) Delete the superseded cycle generations and repoint the tests and consumers that name them. (4) `/charts` imports from `basalt-ui/charts`; `/table` uses `detail` and `detailState`. (5) apps/playground/AGENTS.md states what is tour, kit, reference and test fixture, and where the carve-outs live. (6) The four parts with no consumer anywhere (`CardMenu`, `CardChip`, `FrameHead`, `useWindowChrome`): use each on a tour page where it belongs or delete it with its migration row. What the code decides: which existing page serves each tour stop.
acceptance: The nav has at most 40 entries; the tour pages pass `basalt-ui lint` with no waiver and no `custom` column
Frames of every tour page at 1800x1200 and 390x844, light and dark, in the PR, and the design reviewer run on them with no P1
The layout suite and the full quality matrix pass; no waiver matches nothing
out_of_scope: Pruning the expression scenarios (an owner call). New kit parts.
proof: The tour frames and the reviewer result.
commits: Conventional, empty scope, header at most 80 characters, packages/basalt-ui/** in its own commits. Never feat!: and no BREAKING CHANGE footer (docs/release.md). A changed or removed export, prop, rule id or CLI flag gets its row in migrations/areas and MIGRATING.md and regenerates the docs in the same PR.
